prompt: In the vault fixture at evals/files/new-project-vault, create a new project note for migrating our team wiki to Obsidian. The deadline is 2026-10-15, the expected outcome is a working migration with the old wiki archived, and use the existing tags where possible. Update the index and activity log too.
assertions: Exactly one new project note is created below projects/ and it has required frontmatter.
The project note contains the deadline and requested outcome.
The project note has a lowercase hyphenated filename and at least two wikilinks.
index.md and log.md contain entries for the new project.
No ref/ or _raw/ files are modified.
